fp_insights.insight:
This chart compares your current prices with market rates for listings in the **4, 5 and 6** bedroom category. You can change the market comparison by filtering from the top right menu.
- **High Season Months**: July, October, December, June
  - During these months, your prices are above the market.

- **Low Season Months**: January, February
  - During these months, your prices are also above the market.

- **Surge in Prices**:
  - **<span style="color:#1976f3" children="23rd November 2026"/> to <span style="color:#1976f3" children="26th November 2026"/>**: Market prices are **80.1% ** higher compared to surrounding dates.
  - **<span style="color:#3d9635" children="22nd December 2026"/> to <span style="color:#3d9635" children="30th December 2026"/>**: Market prices are **36.1% ** higher compared to surrounding dates.
  - **<span style="color:#f37d26" children="3rd September 2026"/> to <span style="color:#f37d26" children="6th September 2026"/>**: Market prices are **27.0% ** higher compared to surrounding dates.

occ_insights.insight:
The occupancy chart tracks how often the listings in the market are booked and how these bookings change over time. This can help you see what times of year are most popular and how they relate to prices. Market for this analysis is defined by the **4, 5 and 6** bedroom category listings in the neighborhood, you can change the market comparison from the top right menu.
- **Weekend Travel Market**: Occupancy is consistently higher on weekends compared to weekdays.
- **Next 5 Months Performance**: Occupancy rates are significantly better compared to the same period last year.
- **Market Seasonality**: Strong seasonality is present, indicating predictable fluctuations in demand.

- **Surge in Demand**:
  - **<span style="color:#1976f3" children="24th November 2026"/> to <span style="color:#1976f3" children="27th November 2026"/>**: Occupancy increases by **26.0% ** compared to surrounding dates.
  - **<span style="color:#3d9635" children="6th September 2026"/>**: Occupancy increases by **22.4% ** compared to surrounding dates.
  - **<span style="color:#f37d26" children="22nd October 2026"/> to <span style="color:#f37d26" children="24th October 2026"/>**: Occupancy increases by **10.7% ** compared to surrounding dates.

summary_outline_for_llm: 1) Open: listing name/id; data is PriceLabs neighbourhood/market intelligence—not a forecast or guarantee.
2) If initialize OK: from data.initialize (incl. `raw` JSON if present)—bedroom band, comp scale, market framing; summarize, do not dump every comp unless asked.
3) If fp_insights OK: blend data.fp_insights.graph_data (dated prices) with `insight` text—future prices vs market for the selected bedroom band; quote %/amounts from payload; paraphrase past HTML.
4) If occ_insights OK: blend graph_data (occupancy %) with `insight`—demand, seasonality, spikes vs market; same quoting/HTML rules.
5) Close: 2–4 actionable bullets. If any shard failed or meta.all_operations_ok is false, say what succeeded vs what is missing—no guessing.

_docs.purpose: Neighbourhood intelligence in three parts: comp/market setup (initialize), future prices vs market (fp_insights), occupancy/demand vs market (occ_insights). Full CCC rows: mcp/listings/get_competitor_data.
_docs.data_initialize: May include `raw`: a JSON string with comp options, bedroom band, filters—high volume. Summarize market framing and comp scale; do not list every comp unless asked.
_docs.data_fp_insights: `graph_data` = dated price points with marker colors; `insight` = narrative (often markdown/HTML). Future-price positioning vs the selected bedroom band—quote numbers from the payload; ignore HTML tags when paraphrasing.
_docs.data_occ_insights: `graph_data` = dated occupancy % and colors; `insight` = demand, seasonality, spikes vs market. Same quoting and HTML rules as fp_insights.
_docs.reliability: Use a shard only if meta.<initialize|fp_insights|occ_insights>.http_status is 200 and error is blank. If initialize failed, fp/occ may be skipped placeholders.
_docs.llm_notes: Not a guarantee of future performance. If meta.error or not all_operations_ok, state uncertainty. No invented figures, comp counts, or rankings. Neutral, actionable tone; no legal or investment advice.
